description: This example lexes, parses, and evaluates a Mini Fibonacci program.

steps.description: The comments identify the full pipeline. The imports provide lexer, parser, interpreter, and environment components.
source defines recursive fib and asks Mini to print fib(10).
The example creates an interpreter, parses the source into a tree, and evaluates it in the global environment.
The comment states that this program's expected output is 55.

title: Run Fibonacci through the pipeline
